*
FROM (
  SELECT "Beetles".gen_ob_id, beetle_identifier, taxon, life_stage, sex, sample_size,
         sampling_protocol, comes_from, vial_number, country, state_or_province,
         county, locality, latitude, longitude, date_created, by_member, for_project,
         "GeneratedObjects".notes
  FROM "Beetles"
  JOIN "GeneratedObjects" ON "Beetles".gen_ob_id = "GeneratedObjects".gen_ob_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN "SampleDerivations" ON "GeneratedObjects".gen_ob_id = "SampleDerivations".sample_object
  LEFT OUTER JOIN "Identifications" ON "Beetles".gen_ob_id = "Identifications".ided_ob_id
  WHERE (
      ("Identifications".ided_ob_id, "Identifications".date_identified) IN (
        SELECT ided_ob_id, MAX(date_identified)
        FROM "Identifications"
        GROUP BY ided_ob_id
      )
      OR "Beetles".gen_ob_id NOT IN (
        SELECT ided_ob_id FROM "Identifications"
      )
    )
    AND for_project = ANY({{ projectSelector.value }})
    AND by_member = ANY({{ memberSelector.value }})
    AND (life_stage = ANY({{ lifeStage.value }}) OR (life_stage IS NULL AND {{ nullSwitch.value }} = TRUE))
    AND (sex = ANY({{ sexSelector.value }}) OR (sex IS NULL AND {{ nullSwitch.value }} = TRUE))
    AND sampling_protocol = ANY({{ samplingProtocol.value }})
    AND CAST(date_created as DATE) >= CAST({{ dateRange.value.start }} as DATE)
    AND CAST(date_created as DATE) <= CAST({{ dateRange.value.end }} as DATE)
    AND sample_size >= CAST({{ sampleSize.value.start }} AS integer)
    AND sample_size <= CAST({{ sampleSize.value.end }} AS integer)
    AND (
  latitude >= CAST({{ latitudeSelector.value.start }} AS integer)
      AND latitude <= CAST({{ latitudeSelector.value.end }} AS integer)
      OR (latitude IS NULL AND {{ fullLat.value }} = TRUE))
    AND (
  longitude >= CAST({{ longitudeSelector.value.start }} AS integer)
      AND longitude <= CAST({{ longitudeSelector.value.end }} AS integer)
      OR (longitude IS NULL AND {{ fullLong.value }} = TRUE))
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM unnest({{ beetleIDSearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
        WHERE beetle_identifier LIKE '%' || term || '%'
      )
    )
) AS big_query
WHERE (
  comes_from = ANY({{ prospectiveSourceSearch.value }})
  OR (
    (comes_from IS NULL OR comes_from::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ prospectiveSourceSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ taxonSearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE taxon LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (taxon IS NULL OR taxon::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ taxonSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ vialNumberSearch.value }}::integer[]) AS term
    WHERE vial_number = term
  )
  OR (
    (vial_number IS NULL OR vial_number::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ vialNumberSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ countrySearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE country LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (country IS NULL OR country::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ countrySearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ stateSearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE state_or_province LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (state_or_province IS NULL OR state_or_province::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ stateSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ countySearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE county LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (county IS NULL OR county::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ countySearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ localitySearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE locality LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (locality IS NULL OR locality::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ localitySearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ notesSearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE notes LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (notes IS NULL OR notes::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ notesSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
  
ORDER BY date_created DESC, beetle_identifier;
